3076! f single gaussian orbital
3077! radial R(r)= exp(-alpha r^2)
3078! normalized
3079
3080! metric set by boundary conditions
3081! general representation X_i(x_i) where x_i are the plain cartesian coordinates
3082! X_i are the stretched coordinates for the radial part R
3083! Y_i are the stretched coordinates for the angular part A
3084
3085! general form of the orbital \Psi(x_i) = R(X_i(x_i)) A(Y_i(x_i)) \phi(x_i)
3086! R depends on X_i, A depends on Y_i, the phase \phi depends on x_i
3087
3088! gradient
3089! d/dx_k \Psi(x_i) = (d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i))) \phi(x_i) + F(X_i(x_i)) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)
3090! where d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i)) = (d/dX_k R) A (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i) + R (d/dY_k R) A (d/dx_k Y_i) (x_i)
3091! (d/dX_k R) (d/dY_k A) are calculated as in makefun but evaluated at stretched coordinates X_k Y_k
3092
3093!laplacian
3094! d^2/dx^2_k \Psi(x_i) = (d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i(x_i))) \phi(x_i)
3095! + 2.d0 (d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i))) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)
3096! + F(X_i(x_i)) d^2/dx^2_k \phi(x_i)
3097! where d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i(x_i)) = (d^2/dX^2_k R) A ((d/dx_k X_i) (x_i))^2
3098! + (d/dX_k R) (X_i(x_i)) A (d^2/dx^2_k X_i) (x_i)
3099! + R (d^2/dY^2_k A) ((d/dx_k Y_i) (x_i))^2
3100! + R (d/dY_k A) (d^2/dx^2_k Y_i) (x_i)
3101! + 2 (d/dX_k R) (d/dY_k A) (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i) (d/dx_k Y_i) (x_i)
3102
3103! X_i = rmu
3104! Y_i = rmu * rmucos
3105! d/dx_k X_i = rmucos
3106! d^2/dx^2_k X_i = - Pi/L * rmusin
3107! d/dx_k Y_i = 2 * rmucos**2 - 1
3108! d^2/dx^2_k Y_i = - 4*Pi/L * rmusin * rmucos

3354 rp1=3.d0*cost4f*((rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**2-(rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**2)
3355 rp2=6.d0*cost4f*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)
3356 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
3357 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
3358 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
3359 elseif(i.eq.2) then
3360 rp1=-6.d0*cost4f*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)
3361 rp2=-6.d0*cost4f*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)
3362 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
3363 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
3364 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
3365 endif
3366 else
3367 if(i.eq.1) then
3368 rp1=6.d0*cost4f*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)
3369 rp2=6.d0*cost4f*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)
3370 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
3371 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
3372 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
3373 elseif(i.eq.2) then
3374 rp1=3.d0*cost4f*((rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**2-(rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**2)
3375 rp2=-6.d0*cost4f*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)
3376 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
3377 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
3378 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
3379 endif
3380 !endif for ic
3381 endif
3382 !enddo for i
3383
3384! gradient (without phase)
3385! compute (d/dX_k F) (X_i(x_i)) (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i)
3386 z(indorbp,indt+i)=der4f(1)*rmucos(i,0) &
3387 & +der4f(2)*(2.d0*rmucos(i,0)**2-1.d0)
3388
3389! part of the laplacian (without phase)
3390! compute d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i) = (d^2/dX^2_k R) A ((d/dx_k X_i) (x_i))^2
3391! + (d/dX_k R) (X_i(x_i)) A (d^2/dx^2_k X_i) (x_i)
3392! + R (d^2/dY^2_k A) ((d/dx_k Y_i) (x_i))^2
3393! + R (d/dY_k A) (d^2/dx^2_k Y_i) (x_i)
3394! + 2 (d/dX_k R) (d/dY_k A) (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i) (d/dx_k Y_i) (x_i)
3395
3396 hess4f(1)=hess4f(1)*rmucos(i,0)**2 &
3397 & -der4f(1)*pi/cellscale(i)*rmusin(i,0) &
3398 & +hess4f(2)*(2.d0*rmucos(i,0)**2-1.d0)**2 &
3399 & -der4f(2)*4.d0*pi/cellscale(i)*rmusin(i,0)*rmucos(i,0) &
3400 & +hess4f(3)*rmucos(i,0)*(2.d0*rmucos(i,0)**2-1.d0)
3401
3402! rest of laplacian (with the phase)
3403! d^2/dx^2_k \Psi(X_i) = d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i) \phi(x_i) + 2 d/dx_k F(X_i) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)
3404! + F(X_i) d^2/dx^2_k \phi(x_i)
3405! d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i) already computed and stored in hess4f(k)
3406! d/dx_k F(X_i) already computed and stored in z(indorbp,indt+k)
3407! F(X_i) = distp(0,1)*distp(0,1+ic)
3408 hess4f(1)=hess4f(1)*cosphase(0) &
3409 -2.d0*z(indorbp,indt+i)*sinphase(i,0)*rphase(i) &
3410 -distp(0,1)*distp(0,1+ic)*cosphase(0)*rphase(i)**2
3411
3412! gradient (with the phase)
3413! compute d/dx_k \Psi(X_i)
3414! (d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i))) \phi(x_i) + F(X_i(x_i)) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)
3415 z(indorbp,indt+i)=z(indorbp,indt+i)*cosphase(0) &
3416 -distp(0,1)*distp(0,1+ic)*sinphase(i,0)*rphase(i)
3417
3418! z_xyz(indorbp,i)=hess4f(1)
3419
3420 z(indorbp,indt+4)=z(indorbp,indt+4)+hess4f(1)
3421
3422 enddo
3423
3424
3425 endif
3426 ! enddo fot ic
3427 enddo
3428 endif

3435 case(49)
3436! f single gaussian orbital derivative of 48
3437! R(r)= c*exp(-z r^2)*(9/4/z-r^2)
3438
3439! metric set by boundary conditions
3440! general representation X_i(x_i) where x_i are the plain cartesian coordinates
3441! X_i are the stretched coordinates for the radial part R
3442! Y_i are the stretched coordinates for the angular part A
3443
3444! general form of the orbital \Psi(x_i) = R(X_i(x_i)) A(Y_i(x_i)) \phi(x_i)
3445! R depends on X_i, A depends on Y_i, the phase \phi depends on x_i
3446
3447! gradient
3448! d/dx_k \Psi(x_i) = (d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i))) \phi(x_i) + F(X_i(x_i)) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)
3449! where d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i)) = (d/dX_k R) A (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i) + R (d/dY_k R) A (d/dx_k Y_i) (x_i)
3450! (d/dX_k R) (d/dY_k A) are calculated as in makefun but evaluated at stretched coordinates X_k Y_k
3451
3452!laplacian
3453! d^2/dx^2_k \Psi(x_i) = (d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i(x_i))) \phi(x_i)
3454! + 2.d0 (d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i))) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)
3455! + F(X_i(x_i)) d^2/dx^2_k \phi(x_i)
3456! where d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i(x_i)) = (d^2/dX^2_k R) A ((d/dx_k X_i) (x_i))^2
3457! + (d/dX_k R) (X_i(x_i)) A (d^2/dx^2_k X_i) (x_i)
3458! + R (d^2/dY^2_k A) ((d/dx_k Y_i) (x_i))^2
3459! + R (d/dY_k A) (d^2/dx^2_k Y_i) (x_i)
3460! + 2 (d/dX_k R) (d/dY_k A) (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i) (d/dx_k Y_i) (x_i)
3461
3462! X_i = rmu
3463! Y_i = rmu * rmucos
3464! d/dx_k X_i = rmucos
3465! d^2/dx^2_k X_i = - Pi/L * rmusin
3466! d/dx_k Y_i = 2 * rmucos**2 - 1

3711! + (d/dX_k R) (X_i(x_i)) A (d^2/dx^2_k X_i) (x_i)

3715

3717 & -der4f(1)*pi/cellscale(i)*rmusin(i,0) &

3722! rest of laplacian (with the phase)
3723! d^2/dx^2_k \Psi(X_i) = d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i) \phi(x_i) + 2 d/dx_k F(X_i) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)

3729 -2.d0*z(indorbp,indt+i)*sinphase(i,0)*rphase(i) &
3730 -distp(0,1)*(9.d0/4.d0/dd1-r(0)**2)*distp(0,1+ic)*cosphase(0)*rphase(i)**2

3737

3739 z(indorbp,indt+4)=z(indorbp,indt+4)+hess4f(1)

4064! d^2/dx^2_k \Psi(X_i) = d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i) \phi(x_i) + 2 d/dx_k F(X_i) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)

4076 z(indorbp,indt+i)=z(indorbp,indt+i)*cosphase(0) &
4077 -distp(0,1)*distp(0,1+ic)*sinphase(i,0)*rphase(i)

4080 z(indorbp,indt+4)=z(indorbp,indt+4)+hess4f(1)

4097! f single gaussian orbital derivative of 58
4098! radial R(r)= c*exp(-z r^2)*(9/4/z-r^2)
4099! normalized
4100! orbital with the minimal power of rmucos
4101
4102! metric set by boundary conditions
4103! general representation X_i(x_i) where x_i are the plain cartesian coordinates
4104! X_i are the stretched coordinates for the radial part R
4105
4106! general form of the orbital \Psi(x_i) = R(X_i(x_i)) A(x_i) \phi(x_i)
4107! R depends on X_i, A and the phase \phi depend on x_i
4108
4109! gradient
4110! d/dx_k \Psi(x_i) = (d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i))) \phi(x_i) + F(X_i(x_i)) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)
4111! where d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i)) = (d/dX_k R) A (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i) + R (d/dY_k R) A (d/dx_k Y_i) (x_i)
4112! (d/dX_k R) (d/dY_k A) are calculated as in makefun but evaluated at stretched coordinates X_k Y_k
4113
4114!laplacian
4115! d^2/dx^2_k \Psi(x_i) = (d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i(x_i))) \phi(x_i)
4116! + 2.d0 (d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i))) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)
4117! + F(X_i(x_i)) d^2/dx^2_k \phi(x_i)
4118! d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i) = (d^2/dX^2_k R) A ((d/dx_k X_i) (x_i))^2
4119! + (d/dX_k R) (X_i(x_i)) A (d^2/dx^2_k X_i) (x_i)
4120! + R (d^2/dx^2_k A)
4121! + 2 (d/dX_k R) (d/dx_k A) (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i)
4122
4123! X_i = rmu
4124! d/dx_k X_i = rmucos
4125! d^2/dx^2_k X_i = - Pi/L * rmusin
4126
4127

4130
4131 dd1=dd(indparp)
4132
4133! if(iflagnorm.gt.2) then
4134! overall normalization
4135 c=dd1**2.25d0*1.47215808929909374563d0

4137! endif

4139! radial part
4140 do k=indtmin,indtm

4144! angular part

4146 do i=indtmin,indtm

4149

4160 & *(rmu(1,i)**2-rmu(2,i)**2)

4166 & *(rmu(1,i)**2-3.d0*rmu(2,i)**2)

4168 distp(i,8)=cost4f*rmu(2,i)*rmucos(2,i) &

4442! metric set by boundary conditions
4443! general representation X_i(x_i) where x_i are the plain cartesian coordinates
4444! X_i are the stretched coordinates for the radial part R
4445
4446! general form of the orbital \Psi(x_i) = R(X_i(x_i)) A(x_i) \phi(x_i)
4447! R depends on X_i, A and the phase \phi depend on x_i
4448
4449! gradient
4450! d/dx_k \Psi(x_i) = (d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i))) \phi(x_i) + F(X_i(x_i)) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)
4451! where d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i)) = (d/dX_k R) A (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i) + R (d/dY_k R) A (d/dx_k Y_i) (x_i)
4452! (d/dX_k R) (d/dY_k A) are calculated as in makefun but evaluated at stretched coordinates X_k Y_k
4453
4454!laplacian
4455! d^2/dx^2_k \Psi(x_i) = (d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i(x_i))) \phi(x_i)
4456! + 2.d0 (d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i))) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)
4457! + F(X_i(x_i)) d^2/dx^2_k \phi(x_i)
4458! d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i) = (d^2/dX^2_k R) A ((d/dx_k X_i) (x_i))^2
4459! + (d/dX_k R) (X_i(x_i)) A (d^2/dx^2_k X_i) (x_i)
4460! + R (d^2/dx^2_k A)
4461! + 2 (d/dX_k R) (d/dx_k A) (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i)
4462
4463! X_i = rmu
4464! d/dx_k X_i = rmucos
4465! d^2/dx^2_k X_i = - Pi/L * rmusin
4466
4467
4468 indorbp=indorb
4469 indparp=indpar+1
4470
4471 dd1=dd(indparp)
4472
4473! if(iflagnorm.gt.2) then
4474! overall normalization
4475 c=dd1**4.5d0*0.084104417400672d0

4477! endif

4479! radial part
4480 do k=indtmin,indtm

4482 enddo
4483
4484! angular part
4485! rmu replaced by rmu*rmucos
4486 do i=indtmin,indtm
4487
4488 rp0=r(i)**2
4489
4490 distp(i,2)=cost1f*rmu(3,i)*rmucos(3,i) &
4491 & *(5.d0*rmu(3,i)**2-3.d0*rp0)

4495

4497 & *(5.d0*rmu(3,i)**2-rp0)
4498

4500 & *(rmu(1,i)**2-rmu(2,i)**2)
4501
4502 distp(i,6)=cost3f*2.d0*rmu(3,i)*rmucos(3,i) &
4503 & *rmu(1,i)*rmucos(1,i)*rmu(2,i)*rmucos(2,i)
4504
4505 distp(i,7)=cost4f*rmu(1,i)*rmucos(1,i) &
4506 & *(rmu(1,i)**2-3.d0*rmu(2,i)**2)
4507
4508 distp(i,8)=cost4f*rmu(2,i)*rmucos(2,i) &
4509 & *(3.d0*rmu(1,i)**2-rmu(2,i)**2)

4726! + (d/dX_k R) (X_i(x_i)) A (d^2/dx^2_k X_i) (x_i)

4774 case(71)
4775! f single gaussian orbital derivative of 70
4776! radial R(r)= c*exp(-z r)*(9/2/z-r)
4777! normalized
4778! orbital with the minimal power of rmucos
4779
4780! metric set by boundary conditions
4781! general representation X_i(x_i) where x_i are the plain cartesian coordinates
4782! X_i are the stretched coordinates for the radial part R
4783
4784! general form of the orbital \Psi(x_i) = R(X_i(x_i)) A(x_i) \phi(x_i)
4785! R depends on X_i, A and the phase \phi depend on x_i
4786
4787! gradient
4788! d/dx_k \Psi(x_i) = (d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i))) \phi(x_i) + F(X_i(x_i)) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)
4789! where d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i)) = (d/dX_k R) A (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i) + R (d/dY_k R) A (d/dx_k Y_i) (x_i)
4790! (d/dX_k R) (d/dY_k A) are calculated as in makefun but evaluated at stretched coordinates X_k Y_k
4791
4792!laplacian
4793! d^2/dx^2_k \Psi(x_i) = (d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i(x_i))) \phi(x_i)
4794! + 2.d0 (d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i))) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)
4795! + F(X_i(x_i)) d^2/dx^2_k \phi(x_i)
4796! d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i) = (d^2/dX^2_k R) A ((d/dx_k X_i) (x_i))^2

5157! overall normalization
5158! c=16.d0/dsqrt(105.d0)*(2.d0/pi)**(3.d0/4.d0)*dd1**(11.d0/4.d0)
5159 c=dd1**2.75d0*1.11284691281640568826d0
5160! endif
5161
5162! radial part
5163 do k=indtmin,indtm
5164 distp(k,1)=c*dexp(-dd1*r(k)**2)
5165 enddo
5166
5167! angular part
5168! rmu replaced by rmu*rmucos
5169 do i=indtmin,indtm
5170
5171 rp0=(rmu(1,i)*rmucos(1,i))**2+(rmu(2,i)*rmucos(2,i))**2 &
5172 & +(rmu(3,i)*rmucos(3,i))**2
5173
5174
5175 distp(i,2)=cost1g*(35.d0*rmu(3,i)**4*rmucos(3,i)**4 &
5176 & -30.d0*rmu(3,i)**2*rmucos(3,i)**2*rp0+3.d0*rp0**2)
5177 ! lz=0
5178 distp(i,3)=cost2g*rmu(1,i)*rmucos(1,i)*rmu(3,i)*rmucos(3,i) &
5179 & *(7.d0*rmu(3,i)**2*rmucos(3,i)**2-3.d0*rp0)
5180 ! lz=+/-1
5181 distp(i,4)=cost2g*rmu(2,i)*rmucos(2,i)*rmu(3,i)*rmucos(3,i) &
5182 & *(7.d0*rmu(3,i)**2*rmucos(3,i)**2-3.d0*rp0)
5183 ! lz=+/-1
5184 distp(i,5)=cost3g*(rmu(1,i)**2*rmucos(1,i)**2-rmu(2,i)**2*rmucos(2,i)**2) &
5185 & *(7.d0*rmu(3,i)**2*rmucos(3,i)**2-rp0)
5186 ! lz=+/-2
5187 distp(i,6)=cost3g*2.d0*rmu(1,i)*rmucos(1,i)*rmu(2,i)*rmucos(2,i) &
5188 & *(7.d0*rmu(3,i)**2*rmucos(3,i)**2-rp0)
5189 ! lz=+/-2
5190 distp(i,7)=cost4g*rmu(1,i)*rmucos(1,i)*rmu(3,i)*rmucos(3,i) &
5191 & *(rmu(1,i)**2*rmucos(1,i)**2-3.0*rmu(2,i)**2*rmucos(2,i)**2)
5192 ! lz=+/-3
5193 distp(i,8)=cost4g*rmu(2,i)*rmucos(2,i)*rmu(3,i)*rmucos(3,i) &
5194 & *(3.d0*rmu(1,i)**2*rmucos(1,i)**2-rmu(2,i)**2*rmucos(2,i)**2)
5195 ! lz=+/-3
5196 distp(i,9)=cost5g*(rmu(1,i)**4*rmucos(1,i)**4 &
5197 & -6.d0*rmu(1,i)**2*rmucos(1,i)**2*rmu(2,i)**2*rmucos(2,i)**2+rmu(2,i)**4*rmucos(2,i)**4)
5198 ! lz=+/-4
5199 distp(i,10)=cost5g*4.d0*rmu(1,i)*rmucos(1,i)*rmu(2,i)*rmucos(2,i) &
5200 & *(rmu(1,i)**2*rmucos(1,i)**2-rmu(2,i)**2*rmucos(2,i)**2)
5201 ! lz=+/-4
5202
5203 enddo
5204
5205! definition of the orbital \Psi
5206! radial * angular * phase
5207! F = radial * angular
5208! compute \Psi = F * phase
5209
5210 do ic=1,9
5211 if(iocc(indshell+ic).eq.1) then
5212 indorbp=indorbp+1
5213 do k=i0,indtm
5214 z(indorbp,k)=distp(k,1)*distp(k,1+ic)*cosphase(k)
5215 enddo
5216 endif
5217 enddo
5218
5219! calculate (d/dx_k F) and store them in z(indorbp,indt+k)
5220! calculate (d^2/dx^2_k F) and store them in hess4f(k,indorbp)
5221! d^2/dx^2_k R(x) = (fun2 * x^2_k/r^2 + fun * (1 - x^2_k/r^2))
5222
5223
5224 if(typec.ne.1) then
5225
5226! fun0 = radial
5227! fun = radial'/r
5228! fun2 = radial''
5229
5230 fun0=distp(0,1)
5231 fun=-2.d0*dd1*distp(0,1)
5232 fun2=fun*(1.d0-2.d0*dd1*r(0)**2)
5233 rp0=(rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**2+(rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**2 &
5234 & +(rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0))**2
5235
5236! compute: fun2 * x^2_k/r^2 + fun * (1 - x^2_k/r^2) and store it in radhess4f
5237 do i=1,3
5238 radhess4f(i)=fun2*rmu(i,0)**2/r(0)**2+fun*(1.d0-rmu(i,0)**2/r(0)**2)
5239 enddo
5240
5241 indorbp=indorb
5242 do ic=1,9
5243 if(iocc(indshell+ic).eq.1) then
5244 indorbp=indorbp+1
5245
5246 z(indorbp,indt+4)=0.d0
5247
5248 do i=1,3
5249
5250! derivatives of the radial part
5251! der4f(1) = (d/dx_k R) A
5252 der4f(1)=distp(0,1+ic)*rmu(i,0)*fun
5253! hess4f(1) = (d^2/dx^2_k R) A
5254 hess4f(1)=distp(0,1+ic)*radhess4f(i)
5255
5256! der4f(2) = R (d/dx_k A)
5257! hess4f(2) = R (d^2/dx^2_k A)
5258! hess4f(3) = (d/dx_k R) (d/dx_k A)
5259 der4f(2)=0.d0
5260 hess4f(2)=0.d0
5261 hess4f(3)=0.d0
5262
5263! contribution of the angular part
5264 if(ic.eq.1) then
5265! rp1 = d/dx_k angular
5266! rp2 = d^2/dx^2_k angular
5267 if(i.eq.1) then
5268 rp1=cost1g*(-60.d0*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmu(3,0)**2*rmucos(3,0)**2 &
5269 & +12.d0*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rp0)
5270 rp2=cost1g*12.d0*(3.d0*(rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**2 &
5271 & +(rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**2-4.d0*rmu(3,0)**2*rmucos(3,0)**2)
5272! der4f(2) = der4f(2) + fun0 * d/dx_k angular
5273! hess4f(2) = hess4f(2) + fun0 * d^2/dx^2_k angular
5274! hess4f(3) = hess4f(3) + 2 * fun * x_k * d/dx_k angular
5275 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5276 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
5277 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
5278 elseif(i.eq.2) then
5279 rp1=cost1g*(-60.d0*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)*rmu(3,0)**2*rmucos(3,0)**2 &
5280 & +12.d0*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)*rp0)
5281 rp2=cost1g*12.d0*((rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**2+3.d0*(rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**2 &
5282 & -4.d0*rmu(3,0)**2*rmucos(3,0)**2)
5283 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5284 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
5285 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
5286 else

5288 rp2=-cost1g*48.d0*((rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**2+(rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**2 &
5289 & -2.d0*rmu(3,0)**2*rmucos(3,0)**2)
5290 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5291 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
5292 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
5293 endif
5294 elseif(ic.eq.2) then
5295 if(i.eq.1) then
5296 rp1=cost2g*(-9.d0*(rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**2*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0) &
5297 & -3.d0*(rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**2*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0) &
5298 & +4.d0*rmu(3,0)**3*rmucos(3,0)**3)
5299 rp2=-18.d0*cost2g*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0)
5300 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5301 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
5302 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
5303 elseif(i.eq.2) then
5304 rp1=cost2g*(-6.d0*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0))
5305 rp2=-6.d0*cost2g*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0)
5306 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5307 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
5308 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
5309 else
5310 rp1=cost2g*(-3.d0*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*((rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**2 &
5311 & +(rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**2 &
5312 & -4.d0*rmu(3,0)**2*rmucos(3,0)**2))
5313 rp2=24.d0*cost2g*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0)
5314 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5315 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
5316 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
5317 endif
5318 elseif(ic.eq.3) then
5319 if(i.eq.1) then
5320 rp1=cost2g*(-6.d0*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0))
5321 rp2=-6.d0*cost2g*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0)
5322 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5323 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
5324 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
5325 elseif(i.eq.2) then
5326 rp1=cost2g*(-3.d0*(rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**2*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0) &
5327 & -9.d0*(rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**2*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0) &
5328 & +4.d0*rmu(3,0)**3*rmucos(3,0)**3)
5329 rp2=-18.d0*cost2g*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0)
5330 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5331 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
5332 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
5333 else
5334 rp1=cost2g*(-3.d0*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)*((rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**2 &
5335 & +(rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**2-4.d0*rmu(3,0)**2*rmucos(3,0)**2))
5336 rp2=24.d0*cost2g*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0)
5337 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5338 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
5339 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
5340 endif
5341 elseif(ic.eq.4) then
5342 if(i.eq.1) then
5343 rp1=cost3g*(-4.d0*((rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**3 &
5344 & -3.d0*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmu(3,0)**2*rmucos(3,0)**2))
5345 rp2=-12.d0*cost3g*((rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**2-rmu(3,0)**2*rmucos(3,0)**2)
5346 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5347 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
5348 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
5349 elseif(i.eq.2) then
5350 rp1=cost3g*(4.d0*((rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**3 &

5352 rp2=12.d0*cost3g*((rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**2-rmu(3,0)**2*rmucos(3,0)**2)
5353 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5354 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
5355 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
5356 else
5357 rp1=cost3g*(12.d0*((rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**2 &
5358 & -(rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**2)*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0))
5359 rp2=12.d0*cost3g*((rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**2-(rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**2)
5360 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5361 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
5362 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
5363 endif
5364 elseif(ic.eq.5) then
5365 if(i.eq.1) then
5366 rp1=cost3g*(-2.d0*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)*(3.d0*(rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**2 &
5367 & +(rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**2-6.d0*rmu(3,0)**2*rmucos(3,0)**2))
5368 rp2=-12.d0*cost3g*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)
5369 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5370 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
5371 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
5372 elseif(i.eq.2) then
5373 rp1=cost3g*(-2.d0*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*((rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**2 &

5375 rp2=-12.d0*cost3g*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)
5376 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5377 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
5378 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
5379 else
5380 rp1=cost3g*24.d0*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0)
5381 rp2=cost3g*24.d0*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)
5382 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5383 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
5384 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
5385 endif
5386 elseif(ic.eq.6) then
5387 if(i.eq.1) then
5388 rp1=cost4g*3.d0*((rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**2 &
5389 & -(rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**2)*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0)
5390 rp2=cost4g*6.d0*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0)
5391 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5392 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
5393 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
5394 elseif(i.eq.2) then
5395 rp1=-cost4g*6.d0*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0)
5396 rp2=-cost4g*6.d0*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0)
5397 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5398 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
5399 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
5400 else
5401 rp1=cost4g*((rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**3 &
5402 & -3.d0*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*(rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**2)
5403 rp2=0.d0
5404 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5405 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
5406 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
5407 endif
5408 elseif(ic.eq.7) then
5409 if(i.eq.1) then
5410 rp1=cost4g*6.d0*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0)
5411 rp2=cost4g*6.d0*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0)
5412 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5413 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
5414 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
5415 elseif(i.eq.2) then

5417 & -(rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**2)*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0)
5418 rp2=-cost4g*6.d0*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0)
5419 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5420 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
5421 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
5422 else
5423 rp1=cost4g*(3.d0*(rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**2*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0) &
5424 & -(rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**3)
5425 rp2=0.d0
5426 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5427 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
5428 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
5429 endif
5430 elseif(ic.eq.8) then

5432 rp1=cost5g*4.d0*((rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**3 &
5433 & -3.d0*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*(rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**2)
5434 rp2=cost5g*12.d0*((rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**2-(rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**2)
5435 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5436 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2

5438 elseif(i.eq.2) then

5441 rp2=cost5g*12.d0*((rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**2-(rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**2)
5442 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5443 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2

5445 endif
5446 else

5448 rp1=cost5g*4.d0*(3.d0*(rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0))**2*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0) &
5449 & -(rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**3)
5450 rp2=24.d0*cost5g*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)
5451 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1
5452 hess4f(2)=hess4f(2)+fun0*rp2
5453 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)
5454 elseif(i.eq.2) then

5456 & -3.d0*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*(rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0))**2)
5457 rp2=-24.d0*cost5g*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)
5458 der4f(2)=der4f(2)+fun0*rp1

5460 hess4f(3)=hess4f(3)+2.d0*fun*rp1*rmu(i,0)

5463
5464! gradient (without phase)
5465! compute (d/dX_k F) (X_i(x_i)) (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i)
5466 z(indorbp,indt+i)=der4f(1)*rmucos(i,0) &
5467 & +der4f(2)*(2.d0*rmucos(i,0)**2-1.d0)
5468
5469! part of the laplacian (without phase)
5470! compute d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i) = (d^2/dX^2_k R) A ((d/dx_k X_i) (x_i))^2
5471! + (d/dX_k R) (X_i(x_i)) A (d^2/dx^2_k X_i) (x_i)
5472! + R (d^2/dY^2_k A) ((d/dx_k Y_i) (x_i))^2
5473! + R (d/dY_k A) (d^2/dx^2_k Y_i) (x_i)

5475
5476 hess4f(1)=hess4f(1)*rmucos(i,0)**2 &
5477 & -der4f(1)*pi/cellscale(i)*rmusin(i,0) &
5478 & +hess4f(2)*(2.d0*rmucos(i,0)**2-1.d0)**2 &
5479 & -der4f(2)*4.d0*pi/cellscale(i)*rmusin(i,0)*rmucos(i,0) &

5488 hess4f(1)=hess4f(1)*cosphase(0) &

5491

5495 z(indorbp,indt+i)=z(indorbp,indt+i)*cosphase(0) &
5496 -distp(0,1)*distp(0,1+ic)*sinphase(i,0)*rphase(i)
5497
5498! z_xyz(indorbp,i)=hess4f(1)
5499
5500 z(indorbp,indt+4)=z(indorbp,indt+4)+hess4f(1)
5501
5502 enddo

5505 endif

5531! where d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i)) = (d/dX_k R) A (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i) + R (d/dY_k R) A (d/dx_k Y_i) (x_i)
5532! (d/dX_k R) (d/dY_k A) are calculated as in makefun but evaluated at stretched coordinates X_k Y_k

5536! + 2.d0 (d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i))) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)
5537! + F(X_i(x_i)) d^2/dx^2_k \phi(x_i)

5539! + (d/dX_k R) (X_i(x_i)) A (d^2/dx^2_k X_i) (x_i)

5866! gradient (without phase)
5867! compute (d/dX_k F) (X_i(x_i)) (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i)
5868 z(indorbp,indt+i)=der4f(1)*rmucos(i,0) &
5869 & +der4f(2)*(2.d0*rmucos(i,0)**2-1.d0)
5870
5871! part of the laplacian (without phase)
5872! compute d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i) = (d^2/dX^2_k R) A ((d/dx_k X_i) (x_i))^2
5873! + (d/dX_k R) (X_i(x_i)) A (d^2/dx^2_k X_i) (x_i)
5874! + R (d^2/dY^2_k A) ((d/dx_k Y_i) (x_i))^2
5875! + R (d/dY_k A) (d^2/dx^2_k Y_i) (x_i)
5876! + 2 (d/dX_k R) (d/dY_k A) (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i) (d/dx_k Y_i) (x_i)
5877
5878 hess4f(1)=hess4f(1)*rmucos(i,0)**2 &
5879 & -der4f(1)*pi/cellscale(i)*rmusin(i,0) &
5880 & +hess4f(2)*(2.d0*rmucos(i,0)**2-1.d0)**2 &
5881 & -der4f(2)*4.d0*pi/cellscale(i)*rmusin(i,0)*rmucos(i,0) &
5882 & +hess4f(3)*rmucos(i,0)*(2.d0*rmucos(i,0)**2-1.d0)
5883
5884! rest of laplacian (with the phase)
5885! d^2/dx^2_k \Psi(X_i) = d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i) \phi(x_i) + 2 d/dx_k F(X_i) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)
5886! + F(X_i) d^2/dx^2_k \phi(x_i)
5887! d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i) already computed and stored in hess4f(k)
5888! d/dx_k F(X_i) already computed and stored in z(indorbp,indt+k)
5889! F(X_i) = distp(0,1)*distp(0,1+ic)
5890 hess4f(1)=hess4f(1)*cosphase(0) &
5891 -2.d0*z(indorbp,indt+i)*sinphase(i,0)*rphase(i) &
5892 -distp(0,1)*(11.d0/4.d0/dd1-r(0)**2)*distp(0,1+ic)*cosphase(0)*rphase(i)**2
5893
5894! gradient (with the phase)
5895! compute d/dx_k \Psi(X_i)
5896! (d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i))) \phi(x_i) + F(X_i(x_i)) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)
5897 z(indorbp,indt+i)=z(indorbp,indt+i)*cosphase(0) &
5898 -distp(0,1)*(11.d0/4.d0/dd1-r(0)**2)*distp(0,1+ic)*sinphase(i,0)*rphase(i)
5899
5900! z_xyz(indorbp,i)=hess4f(1)
5901
5902 z(indorbp,indt+4)=z(indorbp,indt+4)+hess4f(1)
5903
5904 enddo

5906
5907 endif

5933! where d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i)) = (d/dX_k R) A (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i) + R (d/dY_k R) A (d/dx_k Y_i) (x_i)
5934! (d/dX_k R) (d/dY_k A) are calculated as in makefun but evaluated at stretched coordinates X_k Y_k
5935

5938! + 2.d0 (d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i))) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)

5941! + (d/dX_k R) (X_i(x_i)) A (d^2/dx^2_k X_i) (x_i)
5942! + R (d^2/dx^2_k A)
5943! + 2 (d/dX_k R) (d/dx_k A) (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i)

7148
7149
7150! gradient (without phase)
7151! compute (d/dX_k F) (X_i(x_i)) (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i)
7152! z(indorbp,indt+i)=der4f(1)*rmucos(i,0) &
7153! & +der4f(2)*(2.d0*rmucos(i,0)**2-1.d0)
7154 z(indorbp,indt+i)=der4f(1)*rmucos(i,0)+der4f(2)
7155
7156! part of the laplacian (without phase)
7157! compute d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i) = (d^2/dX^2_k R) A ((d/dx_k X_i) (x_i))^2
7158! + (d/dX_k R) (X_i(x_i)) A (d^2/dx^2_k X_i) (x_i)
7159! + R (d^2/dx^2_k A)
7160! + 2 (d/dX_k R) (d/dx_k A) (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i)
7161
7162! hess4f(1)=hess4f(1)*rmucos(i,0)**2 &
7163! & -der4f(1)*PI/cellscale(i)*rmusin(i,0) &
7164! & +hess4f(2)*(2.d0*rmucos(i,0)**2-1.d0)**2 &
7165! & -der4f(2)*4.d0*PI/cellscale(i)*rmusin(i,0)*rmucos(i,0) &
7166! & +hess4f(3)*rmucos(i,0)*(2.d0*rmucos(i,0)**2-1.d0)
7167
7168 hess4f(1)=hess4f(1)*rmucos(i,0)**2 &
7169 & -der4f(1)*pi/cellscale(i)*rmusin(i,0) &
7170 & +hess4f(2)+hess4f(3)*rmucos(i,0)
7171
7172
7173! rest of laplacian (with the phase)
7174! d^2/dx^2_k \Psi(X_i) = d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i) \phi(x_i) + 2 d/dx_k F(X_i) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)
7175! + F(X_i) d^2/dx^2_k \phi(x_i)
7176! d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i) already computed and stored in hess4f(k)
7177! d/dx_k F(X_i) already computed and stored in z(indorbp,indt+k)
7178! F(X_i) = distp(0,1)*distp(0,1+ic)
7179 hess4f(1)=hess4f(1)*cosphase(0) &
7180 -2.d0*z(indorbp,indt+i)*sinphase(i,0)*rphase(i) &
7181 -distp(0,1)*distp(0,1+ic)*cosphase(0)*rphase(i)**2
7182
7183! gradient (with the phase)
7184! compute d/dx_k \Psi(X_i)

7215! general form of the orbital \Psi(x_i) = R(X_i(x_i)) A(x_i) \phi(x_i)
7216! R depends on X_i, A and the phase \phi depend on x_i

7218! gradient
7219! d/dx_k \Psi(x_i) = (d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i))) \phi(x_i) + F(X_i(x_i)) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)

7221! (d/dX_k R) (d/dY_k A) are calculated as in makefun but evaluated at stretched coordinates X_k Y_k
7222
7223!laplacian
7224! d^2/dx^2_k \Psi(x_i) = (d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i(x_i))) \phi(x_i)
7225! + 2.d0 (d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i))) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)

7228! + (d/dX_k R) (X_i(x_i)) A (d^2/dx^2_k X_i) (x_i)
7229! + R (d^2/dx^2_k A)

7538 & rmusin(1,0)**2) + 3*rmu(2,0)**2*(-rmucos(1,0)**2 + rmusin(1,0)**2))
7539 elseif(i.eq.2) then
7540 der4f(2)=cost5g*4*rmu(2,0)*(-3*rmu(1,0)**2 + rmu(2,0)**2)*rmucos(2,0)
7541 hess4f(3)=2.d0*fun*rmu(i,0)*der4f(2)
7542 der4f(2)=fun0*der4f(2)
7543 hess4f(2)=-4*cost5g*fun0*(3*rmu(1,0)**2*(rmucos(2,0)**2 - &
7544 & rmusin(2,0)**2) + rmu(2,0)**2*(-3*rmucos(2,0)**2 + rmusin(2,0)**2))
7545 else
7546 der4f(2)=0.d0
7547 hess4f(2)=0.d0
7548 hess4f(3)=0.d0
7549 endif
7550
7551
7552 else
7553
7554 if(i.eq.1) then
7555 der4f(2)=cost5g*4*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)*(rmu(1,0)**2*(3*rmucos(1,0)**2 - &
7556 & rmusin(1,0)**2) + rmu(2,0)**2*(-rmucos(1,0)**2 + rmusin(1,0)**2))
7557 hess4f(3)=2.d0*fun*rmu(i,0)*der4f(2)
7558 der4f(2)=fun0*der4f(2)
7559 hess4f(2)=cost5g*fun0*(8*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmucos(2,0)* &
7560 & (2*rmu(2,0)**2*rmusin(1,0)*pi/cellscale(1) + rmu(1,0)* &
7561 & (3*rmucos(1,0)**2 - 5*rmusin(1,0)**2)))
7562 elseif(i.eq.2) then
7563 der4f(2)=cost5g*4*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*(rmu(1,0)**2*(rmucos(2,0)**2 - &
7564 & rmusin(2,0)**2) + rmu(2,0)**2*(-3*rmucos(2,0)**2 + rmusin(2,0)**2))

7569 & (3*rmucos(2,0)**2 - 5*rmusin(2,0)**2)))

7580! gradient (without phase)
7581! compute (d/dX_k F) (X_i(x_i)) (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i)
7582! z(indorbp,indt+i)=der4f(1)*rmucos(i,0) &
7583! & +der4f(2)*(2.d0*rmucos(i,0)**2-1.d0)
7584 z(indorbp,indt+i)=der4f(1)*rmucos(i,0)+der4f(2)
7585
7586! part of the laplacian (without phase)
7587! compute d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i) = (d^2/dX^2_k R) A ((d/dx_k X_i) (x_i))^2
7588! + (d/dX_k R) (X_i(x_i)) A (d^2/dx^2_k X_i) (x_i)
7589! + R (d^2/dx^2_k A)
7590! + 2 (d/dX_k R) (d/dx_k A) (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i)
7591
7592! hess4f(1)=hess4f(1)*rmucos(i,0)**2 &
7593! & -der4f(1)*PI/cellscale(i)*rmusin(i,0) &
7594! & +hess4f(2)*(2.d0*rmucos(i,0)**2-1.d0)**2 &
7595! & -der4f(2)*4.d0*PI/cellscale(i)*rmusin(i,0)*rmucos(i,0) &
7596! & +hess4f(3)*rmucos(i,0)*(2.d0*rmucos(i,0)**2-1.d0)
7597
7598 hess4f(1)=hess4f(1)*rmucos(i,0)**2 &
7599 & -der4f(1)*pi/cellscale(i)*rmusin(i,0) &
7600 & +hess4f(2)+hess4f(3)*rmucos(i,0)
7601
7602
7603! rest of laplacian (with the phase)
7604! d^2/dx^2_k \Psi(X_i) = d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i) \phi(x_i) + 2 d/dx_k F(X_i) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)
7605! + F(X_i) d^2/dx^2_k \phi(x_i)
7606! d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i) already computed and stored in hess4f(k)
7607! d/dx_k F(X_i) already computed and stored in z(indorbp,indt+k)
7608! F(X_i) = distp(0,1)*distp(0,1+ic)
7609 hess4f(1)=hess4f(1)*cosphase(0) &
7610 -2.d0*z(indorbp,indt+i)*sinphase(i,0)*rphase(i) &
7611 -distp(0,1)*(11.d0/4.d0/dd1-r(0)**2)*distp(0,1+ic)*cosphase(0)*rphase(i)**2
7612
7613! gradient (with the phase)
7614! compute d/dx_k \Psi(X_i)
7615! (d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i))) \phi(x_i) + F(X_i(x_i)) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)
7616 z(indorbp,indt+i)=z(indorbp,indt+i)*cosphase(0) &
7617 -distp(0,1)*(11.d0/4.d0/dd1-r(0)**2)*distp(0,1+ic)*sinphase(i,0)*rphase(i)
7618
7619! z_xyz(indorbp,i)=hess4f(1)
7620 z(indorbp,indt+4)=z(indorbp,indt+4)+hess4f(1)
7621
7622 enddo

8368! d single gaussian orbital
8369! radial R(r)= exp(-alpha r^2)
8370! normalized
8371! orbital with the minimal power of rmucos
8372
8373! metric set by boundary conditions
8374! general representation X_i(x_i) where x_i are the plain cartesian coordinates
8375! X_i are the stretched coordinates for the radial part R
8376
8377! general form of the orbital \Psi(x_i) = R(X_i(x_i)) A(x_i)
8378! R depends on X_i, A depends on x_i
8379
8380! gradient
8381! d/dx_k \Psi(x_i) = (d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i))) \phi(x_i)
8382! where d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i)) = (d/dX_k R) A (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i) + R (d/dY_k R) A (d/dx_k Y_i) (x_i)
8383! (d/dX_k R) (d/dY_k A) are calculated as in makefun but evaluated at stretched coordinates X_k Y_k
8384
8385!laplacian
8386! d^2/dx^2_k \Psi(x_i) = (d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i(x_i))) \phi(x_i)
8387! + 2.d0 (d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i))) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)
8388! + F(X_i(x_i)) d^2/dx^2_k \phi(x_i)
8389! d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i) = (d^2/dX^2_k R) A ((d/dx_k X_i) (x_i))^2
8390! + (d/dX_k R) (X_i(x_i)) A (d^2/dx^2_k X_i) (x_i)
8391! + R (d^2/dx^2_k A)
8392! + 2 (d/dX_k R) (d/dx_k A) (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i)
8393
8394! X_i = rmu
8395! d/dx_k X_i = rmucos
8396! d^2/dx^2_k X_i = - Pi/L * rmusin
8397
8398
8399 indorbp=indorb
8400 indparp=indpar+1
8401
8402 dd(indparp)=abs(dd(indparp))
8403 dd1=dd(indparp)
8404
8405! radial part
8406 do k=indtmin,indtm
8407 distp(k,1)=dexp(-dd1*r(k)**2)
8408 enddo

8410! angular part
8411! rmu replaced by rmu*rmucos with the minimal rmucos strategy
8412 do i=indtmin,indtm
8413
8414 rp0=r(i)**2
8415
8416 distp(i,2)=(3.d0*rmu(3,i)**2-rp0)*cost1d ! lz=0
8417
8418 distp(i,3)=(rmu(1,i)**2-rmu(2,i)**2)*cost2d ! lz=+/-2
8419
8420 distp(i,4)=rmu(1,i)*rmu(2,i) &
8421 &*rmucos(1,i)*rmucos(2,i)*cost3d ! lz=+/-2
8422
8423 distp(i,5)=rmu(2,i)*rmu(3,i) &
8424 &*rmucos(2,i)*rmucos(3,i)*cost3d ! lz=+/-1
8425
8426 distp(i,6)=rmu(1,i)*rmu(3,i) &
8427 &*rmucos(1,i)*rmucos(3,i)*cost3d ! lz=+/-1
8428 ! lz=+/-4
8429 enddo

8431! definition of the orbital \Psi

8434! compute \Psi = F

8459 rp0=r(0)**2
8460
8461! compute: fun2 * x^2_k/r^2 + fun * (1 - x^2_k/r^2) and store it in radhess4f
8462 do i=1,3
8463 radhess4f(i)=fun2*rmu(i,0)**2/r(0)**2+fun*(1.d0-rmu(i,0)**2/r(0)**2)
8464 enddo

8477
8478! hess4f(1) = (d^2/dx^2_k R) A
8479 hess4f(1)=distp(0,1+ic)*radhess4f(i)
8480
8481! contribution of the angular part
8482! der4f(2) = R (d/dx_k A)
8483! hess4f(2) = R (d^2/dx^2_k A)
8484! hess4f(3) = (d/dx_k R) (d/dx_k A)
8485 if(ic.eq.1) then
8486
8487 if(i.eq.1) then
8488
8489 der4f(2)=-2.d0*cost1d*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)
8490 hess4f(3)=2.d0*fun*rmu(i,0)*der4f(2)
8491 der4f(2)=fun0*der4f(2)
8492 hess4f(2)=cost1d*fun0*2.d0*(-rmucos(1,0)**2 + rmusin(1,0)**2)
8493
8494 elseif(i.eq.2) then
8495
8496 der4f(2)=-2.d0*cost1d*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)
8497 hess4f(3)=2.d0*fun*rmu(i,0)*der4f(2)
8498 der4f(2)=fun0*der4f(2)
8499 hess4f(2)=cost1d*fun0*2.d0*(-rmucos(2,0)**2 + rmusin(2,0)**2)
8500
8501 else
8502
8503 der4f(2)=4.d0*cost1d*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0)
8504 hess4f(3)=2.d0*fun*rmu(i,0)*der4f(2)
8505 der4f(2)=fun0*der4f(2)
8506 hess4f(2)=cost1d*fun0*4.d0*(rmucos(3,0)**2-rmusin(3,0)**2)
8507
8508 endif
8509
8510 elseif(ic.eq.2) then
8511
8512 if(i.eq.1) then
8513
8514 der4f(2)=2.d0*cost2d*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)
8515 hess4f(3)=2.d0*fun*rmu(i,0)*der4f(2)
8516 der4f(2)=fun0*der4f(2)
8517 hess4f(2)=cost2d*fun0*2.d0*(rmucos(1,0)**2 - rmusin(1,0)**2)
8518
8519 elseif(i.eq.2) then
8520
8521 der4f(2)=-2.d0*cost2d*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)
8522 hess4f(3)=2.d0*fun*rmu(i,0)*der4f(2)
8523 der4f(2)=fun0*der4f(2)
8524 hess4f(2)=cost2d*fun0*2.d0*(-rmucos(2,0)**2 + rmusin(2,0)**2)
8525
8526 else
8527
8528 der4f(2)=0.d0
8529 hess4f(2)=0.d0
8530 hess4f(3)=0.d0
8531
8532 endif
8533
8534 elseif(ic.eq.3) then
8535
8536 if(i.eq.1) then
8537

8539 hess4f(3)=2.d0*fun*rmu(i,0)*der4f(2)
8540 der4f(2)=fun0*der4f(2)
8541 hess4f(2)=-cost3d*fun0*4.d0*pi/cellscale(1)*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmucos(2,0)*rmusin(1,0)
8542
8543 elseif(i.eq.2) then
8544
8545
8546 der4f(2)=cost3d*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*(rmucos(2,0)**2 - rmusin(2,0)**2)
8547 hess4f(3)=2.d0*fun*rmu(i,0)*der4f(2)
8548 der4f(2)=fun0*der4f(2)
8549 hess4f(2)=-cost3d*fun0*4.d0*pi/cellscale(2)*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmucos(2,0)*rmusin(2,0)
8550
8551 else
8552
8553 der4f(2)=0.d0
8554 hess4f(2)=0.d0
8555 hess4f(3)=0.d0
8556
8557 endif
8558
8559 elseif(ic.eq.4) then
8560
8561 if(i.eq.1) then
8562
8563 der4f(2)=0.d0
8564 hess4f(2)=0.d0
8565 hess4f(3)=0.d0
8566
8567 elseif(i.eq.2) then
8568
8569 der4f(2)=cost3d*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0)*(rmucos(2,0)**2 - rmusin(2,0)**2)
8570 hess4f(3)=2.d0*fun*rmu(i,0)*der4f(2)
8571 der4f(2)=fun0*der4f(2)
8572 hess4f(2)=-cost3d*fun0*4.d0*pi/cellscale(2)*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(2,0)*rmucos(3,0)*rmusin(2,0)
8573
8574 else
8575
8576
8577 der4f(2)=cost3d*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)*(rmucos(3,0)**2 - rmusin(3,0)**2)
8578 hess4f(3)=2.d0*fun*rmu(i,0)*der4f(2)
8579 der4f(2)=fun0*der4f(2)
8580 hess4f(2)=-cost3d*fun0*4.d0*pi/cellscale(3)*rmu(2,0)*rmucos(2,0)*rmucos(3,0)*rmusin(3,0)
8581
8582 endif
8583
8584
8585 else
8586
8587
8588 if(i.eq.1) then
8589
8590 der4f(2)=cost3d*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(3,0)*(rmucos(1,0)**2 - rmusin(1,0)**2)
8591 hess4f(3)=2.d0*fun*rmu(i,0)*der4f(2)
8592 der4f(2)=fun0*der4f(2)
8593 hess4f(2)=-cost3d*fun0*4.d0*pi/cellscale(1)*rmu(3,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmucos(3,0)*rmusin(1,0)
8594
8595 elseif(i.eq.2) then
8596
8597 der4f(2)=0.d0
8598 hess4f(2)=0.d0
8599 hess4f(3)=0.d0
8600
8601 else
8602
8603 der4f(2)=cost3d*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*(rmucos(3,0)**2 - rmusin(3,0)**2)
8604 hess4f(3)=2.d0*fun*rmu(i,0)*der4f(2)
8605 der4f(2)=fun0*der4f(2)
8606 hess4f(2)=-cost3d*fun0*4.d0*pi/cellscale(3)*rmu(1,0)*rmucos(1,0)*rmucos(3,0)*rmusin(3,0)

8608 endif

8614! gradient (without phase)
8615! compute (d/dX_k F) (X_i(x_i)) (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i)
8616 z(indorbp,indt+i)=der4f(1)*rmucos(i,0)+der4f(2)
8617
8618! part of the laplacian (without phase)
8619! compute d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i) = (d^2/dX^2_k R) A ((d/dx_k X_i) (x_i))^2
8620! + (d/dX_k R) (X_i(x_i)) A (d^2/dx^2_k X_i) (x_i)
8621! + R (d^2/dx^2_k A)
8622! + 2 (d/dX_k R) (d/dx_k A) (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i)
8623 hess4f(1)=hess4f(1)*rmucos(i,0)**2 &
8624 & -der4f(1)*pi/cellscale(i)*rmusin(i,0) &
8625 & +hess4f(2)+hess4f(3)*rmucos(i,0)

8953! + 2.d0 (d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i))) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)

8956! + (d/dX_k R) (X_i(x_i)) A (d^2/dx^2_k X_i) (x_i)
8957! + R (d^2/dx^2_k A)

9248! f single gaussian orbital derivative of 154
9249! radial R(r)= -r^2*exp(-z r^2)

9251! orbital with the minimal power of rmucos
9252
9253! metric set by boundary conditions
9254! general representation X_i(x_i) where x_i are the plain cartesian coordinates
9255! X_i are the stretched coordinates for the radial part R
9256
9257! general form of the orbital \Psi(x_i) = R(X_i(x_i)) A(x_i) \phi(x_i)
9258! R depends on X_i, A and the phase \phi depend on x_i
9259
9260! gradient
9261! d/dx_k \Psi(x_i) = (d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i))) \phi(x_i) + F(X_i(x_i)) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)
9262! where d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i)) = (d/dX_k R) A (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i) + R (d/dY_k R) A (d/dx_k Y_i) (x_i)
9263! (d/dX_k R) (d/dY_k A) are calculated as in makefun but evaluated at stretched coordinates X_k Y_k
9264
9265!laplacian
9266! d^2/dx^2_k \Psi(x_i) = (d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i(x_i))) \phi(x_i)
9267! + 2.d0 (d/dx_k F(X_i(x_i))) d/dx_k \phi(x_i)
9268! + F(X_i(x_i)) d^2/dx^2_k \phi(x_i)
9269! d^2/dx^2_k F(X_i) = (d^2/dX^2_k R) A ((d/dx_k X_i) (x_i))^2
9270! + (d/dX_k R) (X_i(x_i)) A (d^2/dx^2_k X_i) (x_i)
9271! + R (d^2/dx^2_k A)
9272! + 2 (d/dX_k R) (d/dx_k A) (d/dx_k X_i) (x_i)

9274! X_i = rmu
9275! d/dx_k X_i = rmucos
9276! d^2/dx^2_k X_i = - Pi/L * rmusin
